faq_q1: Is Povixa truly free to use?
faq_a1: Yes. If your project has no revenue or is open source, simply keep the 'Powered by Povixa' badge in your footer. 100% free forever, no credit card required, zero feature gates.
faq_q2: How does the capped fair-share model work?
faq_a2: When your app generates commercial revenue and you want to remove the badge, you contribute a small percentage of revenue with a fixed hard ceiling. Even if your app scales to millions, your Povixa bill never exceeds the cap.
faq_q3: Can I self-host Povixa on my own infrastructure?
faq_a3: Yes. The entire core is available on GitHub with 4.9k stars. You can deploy it via Docker Compose or Helm in minutes on Hetzner, AWS, or bare metal.
faq_q4: How does the 'Powered by Povixa' badge pact work?
faq_a4: Just embed a single SVG badge code snippet in your footer. It's a mutual community pact: we provide free production infrastructure, you help introduce other builders to Povixa.
faq_q5: Which programming languages and SDKs are supported?
faq_a5: We provide official end-to-end typed SDKs for TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, and Python. We also offer standard REST and gRPC endpoints for any other language.
faq_q6: Can I export all my data if I decide to leave?
faq_a6: Whenever you want. You have complete data sovereignty. No lock-in, ever.
